blocks.title: AI Code Review
blocks.subtitle: Deterministic pipelines × Agent hybrid — line-precise findings, not vague comments

items.title: Built-in defect rules
items.body: NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection ruleset battle-tested at Alibaba's scale, with line-level precision.

items.title: Agent tool
items.body: Say "review my changes" in chat: the code_review tool runs ocr, findings land in the conversation, the model discusses fixes next.

items.title: Severity grouped
items.body: critical / major / minor / info groups, last 20 runs kept for comparison.

items.title: Configure a model endpoint
items.body: ocr needs an OpenAI-compatible endpoint for narrative review — see ocr docs; delegate mode can reuse your current agent.

items.title: Trigger in chat
items.body: "Review my changes" — results also land in the Reviews activity tab.
